newsitem.title: USA: Boston Celtics says unit acquires Dupee shrs.
newsitem.headline: Boston Celtics says unit acquires Dupee shrs.

text.p: Boston Celtics LP said that its indirect, wholly owned subsidiary, Celtics Capital Corp, has acquired 780,000 units from Paul Dupee, who has resigned as vice chairman of the board, for $29.33 per unit.
The units were acquired from Dupee and a partnership which is an affiliate of Dupee, according to the partnership, which owns the Boston Celtics basketball team.
Dupee also resigned as a director of the corporate general partner of the partnership. Dupee resigned from the posts after the units were acquired, the partnership said.
A spokesman for the partnership was not immediately available for further comment.
